items.title: Jimmy Heath — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: After I was appointed I think I got Dr. Donald Byrd over there, and Sir Roland Hanna.

ctx.x: And were you director of jazz studies? What was your position?

Yeah, I was basically that. I had…I was probably the first one that was put on a tenure track. Frank Foster and Bud Johnson, the tenor saxophonist from Earl Hines days who was great composer and saxophonist, was there as an adjunct before I got there. But, I was the first one hired full time at the Aaron Copland School of Music. After I was appointed I think I got Dr. Donald Byrd over there, and Sir Roland Hanna. Since that time, I was instrumental in getting Michael Mossman; he’s the head of the program now. My…
Yes, if a student is a reflection of his teacher, you’ve had some very good students.
